body.p: The Restriction Requirement states that the application contains claims directed to two patentably distinct inventions as outlined below.
Group 1: Claims 1-9, drawn to a method of monitoring a user's breathing, classified
Group 2: Claims 10-20, drawn to a system, classified in A61B2562/0204.
Applicant elects Group 1 with traverse.
In Item 3, the Restriction Requirement states:
In this case, the apparatus of Group II can be used in a process that does not convey instructions to the user via the device. Instead, the apparatus can fail to utilize
instructions altogether.
In Item 4, the Restriction Requirement also states:

Restriction for examination purposes as indicated is proper because all the inventions listed in this action are independent or distinct for the reasons given above and there would be a serious search and/or examination burden if restriction
were not required because one or more of the following reasons apply:
Group I would require a search in at least CPC A61B6/08, along with a
unique text search. Group II would not be searched above and would instead require
a search in at least CPC A61B2562/0204 along with a unique text search.

Applicant respectfully submits that the search and examination of all of the claims can be made without serious burden to the Examiner. Each of independent claims 1, 10, and 19 recites the following claim limitations:
passively monitoring the user's breathing with a device during a
predetermined time interval generating sensor-generated signals, wherein the sensor-generated signals include at least one of acoustic signals or motion signals;
identifying one or more breathing modes of the user's breathing by
processing data created from the sensor-generated signals using a machine learning
model; and
responsive to detecting a trigger mode based on the identifying, generating
an instruction adapted to the trigger mode and conveying the instruction to the user
via the device.
Thus, Groups I and II should be searchable using the same textual search without serious burden to the Examiner.

In addition, Applicant respectfully submits that while the Restriction Requirement indicates that "Group II can be used in a process that does not convey instructions to the user via the device," the claim 10 and claim 19 each explicitly recites "conveying the instruction to the user via the device."

In view of the foregoing, Applicant respectfully submits that the Examiner should examine all the claims on the merits even if the application includes claims to independent or distinct inventions. See MPEP § 803.

This election should not be interpreted or construed as a limitation on the breadth and scope of elected and non-elected claims, but is merely intended as a sufficient response to the Restriction Requirement. Accordingly, Applicant withdraws claims 10-20 from consideration without prejudice. Applicant reserves the right to request rejoinder under MPEP § 821.04, if appropriate, and/or to prosecute any future cancelled claims in one or more subsequent divisional applications.

Reconsideration and a notice of allowance are respectfully requested in view of the amended claims and Remarks presented above. If the Examiner has any questions or concerns, a telephone call to the undersigned is invited.
Respectfully Submitted, Dated: August 10, 2023
Kevin T. Cuenot
Attorney for Applicant
